headings.usage: Use for all main H1-H4 headings. Keep letter-spacing tight (`tracking-tight`).

body.usage: Use for all body text, paragraphs, labels, and small text. Ensure `leading-relaxed` for paragraphs.

marketing.hero: Asymmetric bento grid layout with massive typography. Dark dramatic lighting.
marketing.spacing: Use p-8 to p-16 for sections. Generous breathing room.

dashboard.container: Grid layout, max-w-[1600px] mx-auto, tight gap-4 or gap-6.
dashboard.cards: No generic 'floating' feeling. Ground them with 1px border. Deep blacks.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A1F] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-[#CC4819] hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(255,90,31,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all

cards.base: rounded-2xl p-6 bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 relative overflow-hidden

inputs.base: bg-[#050505] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-[#FF5A1F] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF5A1F] transition-all outline-none

header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 (NO PURE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND)

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up animations for dashboard lists and Kanban boards. Example: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
motion.micro: Scale down active state (active:scale-95) for primary buttons.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (default) + @phosphor-icons/react for premium duotone feel on marketing pages

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Job Recipe', a premium hybrid SaaS and Marketing application.
Dark Mode is MANDATORY. Use the exact Black and Orange colors specified. Ensure high contrast.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use Clash Display (headings) and Satoshi (body). Ensure these fonts are loaded.
For the Kanban Board (Application Tracker), use tight bento-style grids with deep black columns and glassmorphic task cards.
Use Framer Motion for all entrance animations, but keep them subtle and elite (short duration, smooth easing).
Header must have a solid or backdrop-blurred background, NEVER completely transparent.
You have .js files not .tsx files, so write all React components using .jsx/.js standard, NOT TypeScript.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

accessibility.contrast: Always verify orange text against black backgrounds. Use #FF5A1F for buttons with white text to pass APCA/WCAG.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Use data-testid on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Never apply `transition: all` as it breaks specific transforms like Framer Motion.
Never center align the `.App` text by default.
Avoid using generic placeholder images. Use the ones strictly provided in `image_urls`.
Create layered z-index depth. Modals/Dialogs should have a deep #000000/80 backdrop blur overlay.
Ensure the application works seamlessly on Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop (Mobile-First approach with Tailwind).
